inputs.text: This looks less like a straightforward security case and more like a system using national-security laws and the Official Secrets Act to keep someone confined on suspicion while the real evidence stays hidden. The alleged Pakistan contact—and the link to Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri”—make a convenient threat narrative, but the Punjab and Haryana High Court has acknowledged that contact alone cannot justify prolonged incarceration. The account stops before the release directions, so we still don’t know what happened; that silence only makes the official story harder to trust.
